packages/sql-semantics/src/Lowering/Form.php:20
final class Form
Restricted visibility: declared "@visibility SqlSemantics". Code outside that scope must not name this declaration.

A typed, temporary view of one grammar production of a parse tree.

The signature spells the production as the grammar writes it. A rule that dispatches on signatures applies to every grammar release that has the production.
